displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E2.4
meaning: High-limit output relay is not closed when it should be. The service facts say 24 VAC was not sensed on HLO ten times.
causes: 24 VAC not sensed on the high-limit output (HLO) ten times
diySteps: Write down E2.4. This row is the control's high-limit output relay, not an open temperature limit
Technician: the troubleshooting step for fault 2.4 is to replace the integrated furnace control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not replace the limit switch from this page. The chart's action is to replace the IFC.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
